annotations.text:
This is the screen a researcher sees most often.
29 and 30 August had zero amendments — that is real data, not a placeholder.
Today it renders as an empty table, which reads as a broken app.

Scientific changes lead; the other 60 amendments are subordinate but never hidden.
Grouping and the effect lines come from the endpoint that already ships.

The alarm REPLACES the page rather than sitting above it.
A stale feed under a small warning still reads as current — that is the failure being designed out.
